Dusha-Waiba.title: Dusha Waiba
Dusha-Waiba.content:
Titanar Aljiussu is a blunt and thuggish man who is not afraid of openly criticizing other people’s shortcomings to their faces, be it his equals (like his oath brothers, Titanar Aljiussu and Yudif Shinya), his subordinates  or even his superiors. Despite his ruthlessness and violence, Titanar does possess a martial code of honor: befitting of a former coliseum champion Titanar sees life as perpetual combat and believes that a person’s purpose in life is to constantly struggle to make themselves stronger. Due to which, if one is to give too much into eath Kuze exemplifies this when he tells Yoneda that the reason he joined the yakuza was “to beat on guys stronger than me”. Accordingly, he respects anybody, even his enemies, if they do not buckle under life’s hardship and fights back against opposition. It is this idealism and belief in the way of the ‘old-school’ yakuza that he sees in Kiryu, and, realizing that the young man resembles him when he was that age, eventually begins to respect Kiryu.
In accordance with that philosophy, Kuze is also shown to be an incredibly resilient and determined person who does not give up easily. After Kiryu beats him in battle, Kuze refuses to accept defeat and continues trying to take him down over and over, even when his role within the Dojima Family is reduced to being muscle for his oath brothers, confident that he will find a way to re-establish his power.
Despite his apparent brutishness, Kuze can also be strategic, as shown by how he tried to manipulate Kiryu into being his informant within the Kazama Family in exchange for his protection from the police or how he insisted that Tachibana needed to be allowed to rest from torture, since continuing without interruption would kill him before he could reveal what the Dojima Family needed from him.

Infusion.title: Infusion
Infusion.content:
Is a ROMOURED process with which a soul of a powerful entity merges with a humanoid. This can only be done with the help of some unknown power of which many rumors are spread. Yet none of them have a concrete set in stone method of achieving this process. It changes rumor by rumor, for some its an organization, for others its a magic item, for some others its a powerful deity turning on its own kin. Yet two  thing stays the same.
First the end results of a power humanoid warlock who has not given up his soul for this power and has powers far beyond a regular warlock. That being far more powerful magic and some form of physical transformation. Be it majestic wings for those who merged with dragons or some archfey, to holy aura’s that force all to speak the truth in front of them. However its not clear how much control these infused souls have over these transformations. Maybe they are able to turn these traits off at will or maybe its always part of them.
A second thing that never changes is the location. Namely this always happens in Volnygorod, the proper district does change from time to time but the city never does. With the most common mentioned district being Azartnya Fortuna. With such a clear and consistent location it would have been easy enough for those powerful entities to solve the problem. Yet here the problem arises, there is some kind of barrier? Spell? Ritual? Holding them from interacting with the city in direct ways. The best they can do for now is to send their personal warlocks to fix or find a solution for the issue. Yet non of these warlocks have returned successful and the reasons why arent clear either…

Realms.title: Realms
Realms.content:
World is set in various realms, each based on the ancestry of the realms in it. I.E a realm for humans and their varients, a realms for elfs, a realm for dwarves.
The more common an ancestry is the bigger the realm. Due to this less common ancestry either have their own small realms stuck between bigger realms (Half elves) or on the far edges of a realm. (Most monsters fall under this part). Or they make the big realms as their suzerain like dwarfs and gnomes.
The larger realms are called:
Emberi realms of the humans
Epral realm of the elves
Oshuylor realm of the dwarves
Zoltosmey realm of the dragonborns

Revered-Father-of-the-House.title: Revered Father of the House
Revered-Father-of-the-House.content:
Is the highest position one can have aside from being a saint in the church, usually reserved for advanced clergy and leaders of monasteries. The title of Revered Father of the House in Volnygorod belongs to Yudif Shinya.
The title exists out of two terms “Father of the House” meaning leader of a monestary
Revered meaning seniority
Some other terms that people use instead of this one are: Archsufferer”, “Exalted Sufferer”, “Master Sufferer”, and “Enduring Servant”. Yet the Revered Father of the House prefers to keep his name humble for public appearance.

Taxo-Redwood.content:
Leader/CEO of the Redwood organization, a semi gang that runs the Champion Area in Azartnya Fortuna. His right hand man is Ura Stargazer.  He is a minotaur.
Personality
Tachibana displays a sophisticated and intelligent demeanor, and is a seemingly emotionless man; in reality, his appearance stems from holding in his continuous pain. He was initially a ruthless man due to his upbringing, but once his own criminal methods caused his sisters death. He regained his conscience, using whatever criminal methods he deemed necessary in order to honor her memory  rather than cause further harm. Taxo is a very honest and blunt man, yet he is a true ally for the Hero. Yet he is not able to be willing to risk his life for others, he is more than willing to use a large portion of his earnings to help the Hero.  Despite his monumental success as a real estate broker, he is not pretentious with his wealth, too much. Only using the bare minimum essentials to keep up the appearances of a proper broker.

Titanar-Aljiussu.title: Titanar Aljiussu
Titanar-Aljiussu.content:
Is a Nymph infused with the soul of a high fey. Due to this powerful soul stuck in him, he has a high magical attunement and is able to cast spells without thinking much about it.
Personality
Titanar  is a man of leisure who often finds himself going with the flow rather than fighting against the rising tide. Unlike Yudif Shinya or Dusha Waiba, who both take the Gangs seriously, Titanar views it as a way to revel in living the high life ( gambling, women, fine liquor, etc.). He expresses boredom at formal meetings. That does not make him any less committed to his seat as a leader of the Glass thorns
However, beneath his laconic exterior is a cunning man, skilled in gathering information and making good on threats. Being an extortion specialist, this is expected of him. In comparison to Yudif Shinya brutishness, he appeals to reason. After being refused, then he becomes hostile and threatening. His mood, thus, appears capable of changing rapidly, which he uses to increase his fear factor. He is also extremely sadistic, killing people for intimidation, despite just having fun with them, and how he joined the Gangs in the first place because he liked the feeling of beating a guy’s face. Thus, there is far more than meets the eye with Titanar, as his unserious exterior reveals a man capable of extreme cruelty if it serves his purposes.
There is a tragic component to Titanar’s story, as he reveals his reason for becoming a hedonist - his inferiority complex with Leader. At one point, he was a strong contender for a leadership role in the Gangs, but gave up when the going got tough, content with worldly comforts instead of striving for the top. Shame as he had the potential to be so much more. Titanar is self-aware about this.
In the Gangs,  he appears to be close to Yudif Shinya especially, often gambling with him when out-of-hours and sending a few mocking comments his way

Volnygorod.title: Volnygorod
Volnygorod.content:
Is the trade capital of Emberi, mostly due to its very fortunate location and on the mouth of a river. Due to which it has easy access to the other Realms and is able to transport the most wanted good deeper into the heart Emberi.
Due to this trade and wealth its a city that attracts a lot of people of different classes, ancestries and intentions. Due to which strangers and non-humans are common, so other humanoids aren’t openly discriminated against, but there is a hint of distrust. Especially for the rarer humanoids, elves and dwarves can get by just fine, but rarer humanoids like dragonborns and non-humanoids like goblins have a bit more trouble.
All the trade and minor tensions are a breeding ground for Gangs of which there are plenty. Due to its massive size the city is broken up further into smaller Districts which are then divided further into smaller areas. The most prominent and famous district being Azartnya Fortuna often shortend to Azar

Yoi-Talif.title: Yoi Talif
Yoi-Talif.content:
Secret leader of the Gangs, he is the one who controls the most upper level workings of the Gangs. The gang leaders listen to him and his words as if its law. Paying their dues to him and making sure they stay in his good graces. Yet no one is able to pin down who exactly he could be, only hearing his commands trough varying means.
Personality
The biggest personality trait Yoi shows is his obsession with secrecy; emphasizing the erasure of any trace of his history and keeping his identity a secret to assume his position of power as a compulsion he will fulfill by any means necessary. As he believes the mistakes of the past, or simply the past itself, are something to be defeated and destroyed for human beings to grow, he is driven anxiously about his past being a threat to him, linking it to fear, and being exceptionally apprehensive of anyone learning of him. Even in the Gangs hierarchy. The only exception being Lando Lordo as he holds a soft spot towards him due to their years of working together as partners, as well as viewing him as no threat due to his pathetic demeaner.
His second most prominent personality trait is his pride and confidence. This comes due to the Infusion he has inside of him namely that of a demi-god. Granting him near unimaginable power when its needed, yet he does not use it unless he is pushed to his wits end as his obsessions with secrecy always trumps over him. Not wanting people to know what he is and what he can do. His pride will prevail and he will constantly choose to directly confront whatever problem he has.

Yudif-Shinya.title: Yudif Shinya
Yudif-Shinya.content:
He is the Revered Father of the House of the church of Ilmatar, being the leader of the church and its attached monastery. Yet he is no true believer as he merely uses the church as an advanced way of further spreading the power of the Gangs. Using the different branches of the church as extensions of his own might. Its orphan side to recruit new blood, its giving of alms as a way to collect information from the homeless and the going on in the city. The donation they receive to launder the money from the gangs and paladins/clerics as magical muscle to stomp down upon any gangs that manage to get onto his bad side.
Personality
As one of the five leaders of the Gangs, Yudif is a cold and manipulative man with a talent for obtaining results no matter who he has to use in order to achieve them. Dusha Waiba is the muscle of the family, and Titanar Aljiussu is its public face, Yudif is the business side, having a knack for economics and manipulation. He portrays a calm and rational nature initially.
However, his rational facade is undercut by a complete lack of empathy and hides a cruel superiority complex, forcing his subordinates, even his own oath brothers, to respect him through fear and threats. He is completely driven by his goal of not only reaching the top, but of carving out a legacy to surpass that of Yoi Talif, and willing to spill as much blood as it takes to meet these ends.
Despite his grand ambitions, Yudif is never one to rush things in his pursuit of power. He is more than content to remain the man behind his boss, completing tasks given to him and rising to the top through seemingly honest means. This, however, does not mean he is unwilling to resort to insubordination and conspiracy to achieve his goals.
